scope: Adds opt-in native single-open and configurable first-open behavior for structured-v1 Accordion nodes. This is one D-06 slice only; it does not close D-06, D-01–D-07, or complete Editor acceptance.

change.behavior: Accordion Inspector now exposes singleOpen (strict boolean, default false) and openFirst (strict true or absent legacy default true). The renderer uses native details name groups scoped by safe Page Model node ID, so an exclusive disclosure interaction in one Accordion cannot close another. Save persists Page Model properties; only separate Publish changes public output. Existing content model shape remains unchanged.
change.reused_code: Existing structured-content sanitizer, collision-resistant DOM IDs, element.update command path, and Save/Publish pipeline; no third-party source or new dependency.
